S_G_R_GETTER_FURNACE.title: Getter Furnace
S_G_R_GETTER_FURNACE.description: At the start of each combat, gain 1 [gold]Ki[/gold].
S_G_R_GETTER_FURNACE.flavor: The core of a Getter machine, filled with endless evolutionary power.
S_G_R_EMPERORS_FRAGMENT.title: Emperor's Fragment
S_G_R_EMPERORS_FRAGMENT.description: At the start of each combat, gain 2 [gold]Ki[/gold]. Your [gold]Ki[/gold] does not decrease when you take damage.
S_G_R_EMPERORS_FRAGMENT.flavor: A shard of armor peeled from an incomprehensible future, still leaking Getter Rays.
S_G_R_BATTLE_INSTINCT.title: Battle Instinct
S_G_R_BATTLE_INSTINCT.description: After your first [gold]Transform[/gold] each combat, gain 5 [gold]Vigor[/gold].
S_G_R_BATTLE_INSTINCT.flavor: Not courage, not reason, only the instinct to never fall back.
S_G_R_ALLOY_PLATE.title: Alloy Plate
S_G_R_ALLOY_PLATE.description: During your turn, damage taken is halved.
S_G_R_ALLOY_PLATE.flavor: Heavy, twisted, full of cracks. Still usable.
S_G_R_RESEARCH_NOTES.title: Research Notes
S_G_R_RESEARCH_NOTES.description: [gold]Radiation[/gold] no longer increases the damage you take.
S_G_R_RESEARCH_NOTES.flavor: In the manuscripts left by the Saotome Institute, some formulas seem to stare back at the reader.
S_G_R_MUSASHI_CLONE.title: Spare Musashi Clone
S_G_R_MUSASHI_CLONE.description: While in [gold]Shin Getter 3[/gold], when you would take fatal damage, heal 30% HP. Once per combat.
S_G_R_MUSASHI_CLONE.flavor: This time, he still chooses to stay behind.
S_G_R_GOOD_CITIZEN_CARD.title: Good Citizen Card
S_G_R_GOOD_CITIZEN_CARD.description: Your first shop purchase is free. Once per floor.
S_G_R_GO_NAGAI_SMILE.title: Go Nagai's Smile
S_G_R_GO_NAGAI_SMILE.description: At the start of each combat, add 1 random [gold]Spirit Command card[/gold] to your hand.
S_G_R_GO_NAGAI_SMILE.flavor: A rough-lined smile sits in the corner like a signature. The next panel is probably an explosion.
S_G_R_KEN_ISHIKAWA_MANUSCRIPT.title: Ken Ishikawa Manuscript
S_G_R_KEN_ISHIKAWA_MANUSCRIPT.descriptio: On pickup, add 1 [gold]Infinite Evolution[/gold] to your deck.
S_G_R_KEN_ISHIKAWA_MANUSCRIPT.flavor: The end of the storyboard is not an ending, but something far larger.
S_G_R_YUMMY_COOKIE.title: Yummy Cookie - Shin Getter
S_G_R_YUMMY_COOKIE.flavor: Baked in Getter Rays, it makes evolution smell unexpectedly delicious.
S_G_R_TRIPLE_WOOD_CARVING.title: Triple Wood Carving
S_G_R_TRIPLE_WOOD_CARVING.description: At the start of combat, [gold]Transform[/gold] 1 to 3 times at random.
S_G_R_TRIPLE_WOOD_CARVING.flavor: Bird, snake, and ring become one beneath red, white, and yellow light.
S_G_R_BEACON_PRISM.title: Beacon Prism
S_G_R_BEACON_PRISM.description: In each combat, the Nth Potion you use makes you take N unblocked damage and gain N [gold]Ki[/gold] (starting at 1).
S_G_R_BEACON_PRISM.flavor: The beacon's afterglow was folded into a prism, along with every layer of water pressure.
S_G_R_MYCELIAL_SILENCER.title: Mycelial Silencer
S_G_R_MYCELIAL_SILENCER.description: After the first card you Exhaust each turn, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
S_G_R_MYCELIAL_SILENCER.flavor: Mute one beat of the chorus, and the rest can no longer press into the cockpit.
